verdict.rationale: Unleash documents environments that represent lifecycle stages, each with its own feature flag configuration. This lets a flag be enabled in development or test without being enabled in production. Backend API tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment, which gives scoped SDK keys per environment. missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of the environment and token scoping workflow, explicit dev/staging/prod setup detail.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage separate environments (dev/staging/prod) with independent flag states and scoped SDK keys

citations.quote: Environments represent different stages in your development lifecycle. They allow you to manage your product releases from local development to production.
each environment has different feature flag configurations. This allows you to enable a flag in development or test without enabling it in production.
Backend tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment.
Backend tokens for connecting backend SDKs or Unleash Edge to Unleash.
